title: Upper bound for coordinate correction probability
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb N$, every Boolean function $f:\{−1,1\}^{2^n}\to\{−1,1\}$, every coordinate $j\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and every bit $b\in\{0,1\}$, the probability that the local correction of $f$ agrees with the sign encoding of $b$, under a uniformly random input in $\mathbb F_2^{2^n}$, is at most $1$.
